mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals active monetary easing that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns in the first 20 trading days of a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% annually signals inflationary pressure that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction (HOUST) exceeding 1250 thousand units signals housing market recovery that drives broader economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days in recovery regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1250, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
